page.summary: While injured, earn a future self-heal through basic Great repair checks, then take the reset only when its safety and timing repay leaving the generator.

verdict.recommendation: Use Road Life as an experimental repair-to-reset option, not a reason to remain injured or abandon an urgent objective for healing.
verdict.soloQ: Build tokens on a safe generator and choose a safe self-heal location only after the live threshold is reached.
verdict.coordinatedSwf: Tell teammates whether you are still repairing or taking the reset so the team does not duplicate a heal or leave rescue coverage empty.
verdict.mainWeakness: The perk needs injury and basic Great repair checks; missed checks reduce tokens, and healing stops repair tempo.

options.whyItsHere: While injured and repairing, basic Great checks build the 6/5/4-token self-heal threshold; no particular repair shell is established as a canonical build.

opening: Take a safe generator first. A Med-Kit is not required for the core loop, and the source does not establish a fixed accessory build.

rows.situation: You are injured, repairing a generator and can attempt basic repair Skill Checks without inviting an immediate down.
rows.action: Hit basic Great checks for one Road Life token each; a missed basic check removes one. Continue objective work until the live 6/5/4 threshold is reached or the location becomes unsafe.
rows.why: The self-heal access is earned through injured repair, not granted by merely equipping the perk.

rows.situation: The Road Life threshold is ready and a safe self-heal would return you to useful work.
rows.action: Leave for cover, begin self-healing to spend all tokens and use the 10% speed bonus. If you stop, resume within the four-second grace period or the granted self-heal ends.
rows.why: A delayed or exposed reset can cost more than continuing repair or taking a teammate heal.

rows.situation: The Killer contests the repair, the heal is unsafe, or the team needs a rescue or critical generator covered.
rows.action: Drop the token-chasing or reset assignment and take the higher-value job; rebuild only if a later injured repair window is genuinely available.
rows.why: Staying injured for tokens or chasing an unsafe heal reverses the objective-to-reset exchange.

abortWhen: Do not stay injured deliberately once the repair route is unsafe; leave without assuming the self-heal is ready.
Stop the self-heal if Killer pressure makes it a likely down, and account for the four-second expiry after stopping.

strengths: Objective work can create independent healing access without a required Med-Kit.
weaknesses: Injury, check accuracy and a safe reset window must coincide; the current strategy remains experimental.
commonMistakes: Reading any Great check as progress toward Road Life when the perk requires injured basic repair checks.
Spending the reset at an unsafe location or treating the four-second post-stop effect as unlimited.
